retention_policy.safe_projection: Derived JSON/JSONL/CSV/YAML/Markdown, validation and audit artifacts, HTML if generated, and safe derived images are retained.
retention_policy.excluded: Credentials, raw workflow databases, raw provider caches, raw usage/provider ledgers, local runtime configuration and source PDF bytes are excluded and listed with reason/hash where available.
retention_policy.manifest_self_reference: artifact_manifest.json is the inventory itself and is intentionally not self-listed to avoid a self-hash cycle.
